cases.name: same-object
cases.trigger: Two bundles share one object
cases.expectation: One verified copy per required place; no per-bundle duplication

cases.name: five-replacements
cases.trigger: Five objects are replaced in current
cases.expectation: Acquire new, retain required history, assess surplus only after fresh checks

cases.name: shared-history
cases.trigger: Old object remains used by another current bundle
cases.expectation: Protect its working-place obligation

cases.name: path-version
cases.trigger: Same path differs across snapshots
cases.expectation: Resolve by exact snapshot and path; never latest-path substitution

cases.name: rename
cases.trigger: Logical path renamed with identical bytes
cases.expectation: Manifest update can require zero payload transfer

cases.name: policy-label
cases.trigger: Admitted lifecycle label changes
cases.expectation: Pinned policy changes desired placement; descriptive labels do nothing

cases.name: archive-present
cases.trigger: Required archive already verified present
cases.expectation: No redundant transfer; revalidate admissible custody before eviction

cases.name: archive-offline
cases.trigger: Only alleged archive is offline
cases.expectation: Required custody remains unknown/blocked unless explicit admissible evidence policy applies

cases.name: corrupt-copy
cases.trigger: Destination has right name/size but wrong bytes
cases.expectation: Reject complete observation; preserve good source

cases.name: same-domain
cases.trigger: Two aliases resolve to the same disk
cases.expectation: Do not count as independent retained copies

cases.name: missed-event
cases.trigger: Merge event missed or duplicated
cases.expectation: Catch-up exact refs; idempotent convergent reconciliation

cases.name: stale-plan
cases.trigger: New protection claim arrives after planning
cases.expectation: Fence/replan conflicting removal; preserve valid completed copies

cases.name: parallel-add
cases.trigger: Two sessions add content while eviction runs
cases.expectation: Scoped coordination; no global pause; deduplicate safe promotion

cases.name: crash-copy
cases.trigger: Crash during cross-volume copy
cases.expectation: Partial destination not complete; resume/retry with source protected

cases.name: full-disk
cases.trigger: Scratch/capacity exhausted
cases.expectation: Bounded refusal/recovery; no full duplicate staging

cases.name: missing-capability
cases.trigger: Provider cannot fence or verify retention
cases.expectation: Expose unsupported action rather than a fabricated pass

cases.name: large-tree
cases.trigger: One entry changes in a huge index
cases.expectation: Reuse unaffected chunks; measure metadata and physical write amplification

cases.name: pack-pinning
cases.trigger: Dropped object shares a pack with a protected one
cases.expectation: May reclaim zero; explicit budgeted compaction is separate

cases.name: sparse-claim
cases.trigger: Destination constraints partially specified
cases.expectation: Plan stays unresolved until defaults/assignment are explicit

cases.name: conflict
cases.trigger: Two policies impose incompatible locations/budgets
cases.expectation: Declared precedence or unsatisfied obligations; no last-writer choice

cases.name: untrusted-path
cases.trigger: Malicious tree or torrent path escapes root
cases.expectation: Reject before IO; normalize with explicit cross-platform rules

cases.name: torrent-reuse
cases.trigger: New checkpoint reuses most shard torrents
cases.expectation: Acquire missing shards only; prove client local reuse/no duplicate staging

cases.name: peer-loss
cases.trigger: Seeder leaves after a successful download
cases.expectation: Availability observation changes; retained custody independently assessed

cases.name: expired-claim
cases.trigger: Draft claim expires while a job uses its objects
cases.expectation: Active admitted job remains protected; expiry does not erase other claims

cases.name: non-media
cases.trigger: Synthetic document bundles use remote and local stores
cases.expectation: No episode/language/golden assumptions; same generic placement rules
